positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked on Indoor Positioning project using WiFi Fingerprinting.
Developed an internal-used android app supporting the functionality of WiFi data collection, transmission and visualization.
Implemented a sophisticated model estimation technique in the back-end engine to optimize the positioning result by reducing 27% error and 80% computational time.
Benchmarked and analyzed the performance with other company’s solution.

projects.title: Operating Systems Design and Implementation
projects.description:
